choice.basis: The chart provides labeled data points that allow for a definitive comparison. The blue line (0-14 years) is annotated with '14.82%' near 2013 and '14.2%' near 2017. Given the monotonic decline of the blue line, the 2014 value must be between 14.2% and 14.82%. The red line (65 years +) is annotated with '20.1%' near 2013 and '21.4%' near 2017. Given the monotonic increase of the red line, the 2014 value must be between 20.1% and 21.4%. Comparing these ranges, the 2014 share for 65 years + (approx. 20-21%) is strictly larger than the 2014 share for 0-14 years (approx. 14-15%).
